Underline Links listing copy vs hyperlink styling engineering — two different jobs

US/EU indie teams conflate in-app link underline styling with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • Underline Links on the device — iOS always underlines hyperlinks system-wide when the toggle is on, so text links are visually distinguishable from non-link body text. Toggle under Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Underline Links. System accessibility behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Hyperlink styling and link-affordance engineering — code that checks UIAccessibility.shouldUnderlineLinks, adapts NSAttributedString or SwiftUI Link appearance, and ensures in-app tappable links remain visible when system Underline Links is enabled. Engineering inside the binary — not listing rewrite.
  • Underline Links marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app respects Underline Links, shows always-underlined hyperlinks, or offers clearer link affordance. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of how strongly your US listing markets Underline Links.

An app that respects Underline Links styling and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe always-underlined hyperlinks and link affordance on the store page, not whether link underlines render inside the app binary.

Underline Links-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Hyperlink-underline marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Underline Links in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 给链接加下划线 for Underline Links, with related buyer language around 链接下划线 (link underline), 始终给链接加下划线 (always underline links), 超链接下划线 (hyperlink underline), 显示与文字大小 (Display & Text Size under 辅助功能 → 无障碍), and 链接可识别性 (link affordance / link recognizability). Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 按钮形状 or Button Shapes terms that belong on Button Shapes pages.

Underline Links vs Button Shapes — do not conflate

Button Shapes adds underlines, borders, and shape outlines on tappable buttons and links system-wide — 按钮形状, 显示按钮形状. Underline Links specifically always underlines hyperlinks — 给链接加下划线 — without necessarily adding button-outline chrome on every control. If your English gallery shows a Button Shapes toggle or button-outline comparison, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to 给链接加下划线 claims unless that frame shows Underline Links. See the Button Shapes listing guide only if button-outline marketing is your lead claim.

Underline Links vs Bold Text — do not conflate

Bold Text makes system text heavier — 粗体文本, 加粗文本 — without adding hyperlink underlines. Underline Links always underlines tappable text links — 给链接加下划线. If your English gallery shows a Bold Text toggle, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to link-underline claims. See the Bold Text listing guide only if heavier typefaces are your lead marketing claim.

Underline Links vs Prefer Horizontal Text — do not conflate

Prefer Horizontal Text forces horizontal layout for vertical-script languages — 横排文字, 优先横排. Underline Links covers always-underlined hyperlinks — 给链接加下划线. If your English gallery shows horizontal-layout demos, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to link-underline claims unless that is what the screenshot depicts. See the Prefer Horizontal Text listing guide only if CJK layout direction is your lead marketing claim.

Underline Links vs Hover Text — do not conflate

Hover Text shows enlarged text in a floating overlay near the pointer when hovering — 悬停文本, 悬停放大文字. Underline Links always underlines hyperlinks system-wide — 给链接加下划线. Pointer-hover magnification is not hyperlink underline styling; do not reuse Hover Text framing on Underline Links toggle frames.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Underline Links and link-affordance search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 给链接加下划线, 链接下划线, and 始终给链接加下划线 each signal different intent from Button Shapes terms like 按钮形状 or Bold Text terms like 粗体文本.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Underline Links" headlines on gallery frames showing Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Underline Links — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. AppLocale FAQ

Is Underline Links the same as Button Shapes?

No. Underline Links always underlines hyperlinks — 给链接加下划线 — so tappable text links stand out from plain copy. Button Shapes adds underlines, borders, and shape outlines on tappable buttons and links system-wide — 按钮形状, 显示按钮形状. See our Button Shapes listing guide for button-outline marketing copy.

Is Underline Links the same as Bold Text?

No. Bold Text makes system text heavier — 粗体文本, 加粗文本 — without adding hyperlink underlines. Underline Links always underlines tappable text links — 给链接加下划线. See our Bold Text listing guide for heavier-typeface marketing copy.

Is Underline Links the same as Prefer Horizontal Text or Hover Text?

No. Prefer Horizontal Text forces horizontal layout for vertical-script languages — 横排文字. Hover Text shows enlarged text near the pointer when hovering — 悬停文本. Underline Links always underlines hyperlinks — 给链接加下划线. See our Prefer Horizontal Text listing guide and Hover Text listing guide for those buyer stories.
